countingRules.dualWriterPattern: Two or more independently reachable Production runtime paths can write the same business object or equivalent durable representations; each path source-traced through handler/service/RPC/table/API; not merely two functions calling the same single writer; exclude test-only, migration-only, and unreachable code.
countingRules.localStorageMockFallbackPath: Production-reachable runtime can read from or write to localStorage, browser persistence, mock data, or a fallback authority; each path has distinct source file, entry point, and behavior; repeated callers of the same underlying mechanism are not double-counted unless independently selectable authorities. Reader+writer of the same localStorage key count as one LOCALSTORAGE authority unless separately selectable.
